task: pick up the cream cheese and place it in the basket

windows.text: Reach the open gripper horizontally across the table toward the cream cheese box.
Reach the open gripper horizontally across the table toward the orange cream cheese box.
Approach the cream cheese box from above, lowering the open gripper to grasp it.
Approach the blue cream cheese box from above, lowering the open gripper toward it.
Grasp the blue cream cheese box from above, closing the gripper fingers around it.
Grasp the blue cream cheese box on the table by closing the gripper fingers around it.
Open the gripper and readjust above the blue cream cheese box.
Grasp the blue cream cheese box on the table by closing the gripper fingers around it.
Lift the blue cream cheese box up off the table, raising it above the surrounding cans.
Lift the blue cream cheese box up off the table, moving it toward the basket.
Carry the blue cream cheese box horizontally over the table toward the basket.
Carry the blue cream cheese box horizontally over the table toward the wicker basket.
Lower the cream cheese down into the basket.
Release the cream cheese into the basket.
Release the cream cheese into the basket and open the gripper.
